# Flespy's Bar & Grill

> Official website guide for Flespy's Bar & Grill, a bar and grill at 670 Fruitdale Drive in Grants Pass, Oregon.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.flespys.com/): Business overview, featured menu items, weekly happenings, patio, lottery room, reviews, hours, and directions.
- [Full Menu](https://www.flespys.com/menu): Current food menu, prices, dietary notice, and ordering options.
- [Events](https://www.flespys.com/events): Weekly karaoke, open mic, food specials, live calendar, and current-event links.
- [Covered Patio](https://www.flespys.com/patio): Year-round patio amenities, games, seating, television, and photo gallery.
- [Oregon Video Lottery](https://www.flespys.com/lottery): Information about the dedicated 21-and-over Oregon Video Lottery room.
- [Visit and FAQ](https://www.flespys.com/visit): Hours, address, phone number, directions, ordering information, and frequently asked questions.

## Official profiles and actions

- [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/flespysbarandgrill): Current announcements, specials, and event updates.
- [Directions](https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=670+Fruitdale+Dr,+Grants+Pass,+OR+97527)
- Call Flespy's at +1-541-244-1678.

Flespy's is open daily from 11 AM to midnight. Menu prices, item availability, and event schedules may change; use the official pages above for current information.
